comments.body: Arf, I thought it would have been simpler to just link the issue but I don't want to close it.... nvm.

Closing this as the reproducer script here doesn't crash anymore. In gh-143008 a general fix for this type of issue, null pointer dereference of self->buffer after detach, was added. Thanks for the report @jackfromeast!
